title: poinciana pulcherrima f. flava
intro: Poinciana pulcherrima f. flava, commonly known as the yellow Hibiscus, is a plant species belonging to the mallow family and is widely cultivated in tropical regions for its vibrant flowers and medicinal properties. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, inflammation, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits such as antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Poinciana pulcherrima f. flava include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and promote wound healing, making it a valuable resource in folk medicine. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
